title: neonauclea ategii
intro: Neonauclea ategii, commonly known as Ateg's Neonauclea, is a plant species native to the Philippines and Indonesia. It is a shrub or small tree that belongs to the Rubiaceae family. Neonauclea ategii has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its reported health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.
